```{r}
#Input parameters - fixed

n<- 24 #population size
ct.rates<-2 #avg number of daily contacts per day
nSeeds<-1 #number of cases starting the epidemic
R0<-1.5 # average number of secondary cases generated per infected individual in a fully susceptible population
inf.param<- R0/(ct.rates)
#pathogen<-"COVID-19" # or "FLU"
t.stop  <- 360 # maximum number of days the simulation is running (if infected cases present)


#Compute the reproduction number related to the selected network. 
source("F:\\Statistics UHasselt\\Semester 4\\Master Thesis\\Master-Thesis---Chau-\\EKPmodify_group.R")
nSim<-100
epi.outbreak<-list()
nSeed<-1062021
set.seed(nSeed)


for (i in 1:nSim){
  print(i)
  group_assign <- c(rep(1, 12), rep(2, 12))  # group 1, group 2

  M <- matrix(c(0.9, 0.1,
                0.1, 0.9), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  
  epi.outbreak[[i]] <- sim.epi(
  n = n,
  ct.rates = 2,
  nSeeds = 1,
  inf.param = inf.param,
  t.stop = t.stop,
  k = 0.2,
  nu_mean = 4.5,
  nu_sd = 2.0,
  mean_ip = 6,
  sd_ip = 2,
  group_assign = group_assign,
  M = M
)
}

# Plotting a few summary measures
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot of the incidence over time for one specific simulation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

total_cases <- sapply(epi.outbreak, function(x) sum(x$status.matrix$infected != 0))
w <- which.max(total_cases)

plot_data <- epi.outbreak[[w]]$sim.info
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = day, y = dailyInc)) +
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", size = 1) +
  geom_area(fill = "firebrick", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Daily Infection Incidence",
       x = "Day", y = "New Cases") +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot attack rate and extinction probability
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Compute attack rates
att.rate <- data.frame(attack_rate = numeric(nSim))

for(i in 1:nSim) {
  total_inf <- length(which(epi.outbreak[[i]]$status.matrix$infected==-1))
  att.rate$attack_rate[i] <- total_inf / n
}

# Metrics
extinction_threshold <- 0.10 #here we assume that and outbreak goes extinct if less
# than 10% of the population is ultimately infected
att.rate$is_extinct <- att.rate$attack_rate < extinction_threshold
extinction_rate <- mean(att.rate$is_extinct)
non_extinct_ar <- att.rate$attack_rate[!att.rate$is_extinct]

# Plotting
par(mfrow=c(1, 3))

# Panel A: All Attack Rates
hist(att.rate$attack_rate, main="Total Attack Rate", xlab="Proportion Infected", col="skyblue")

# Panel B: Extinction Rate
barplot(c(Extinct = extinction_rate, Major = 1 - extinction_rate), 
        main="Outbreak Outcome", col=c("grey", "orange"), ylab="Probability")

# Panel C: Attack Rate (Non-extinct outbreaks)
hist(non_extinct_ar, main="AR (Non-Extinct)", xlab="Proportion Infected", col="orange")
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot Transmission tree
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (dev.cur() != 1) dev.off()
library(igraph)
total_cases <- sapply(epi.outbreak, function(x) sum(x$status.matrix$infected != 0))
w <- which.max(total_cases)
plot_data <- epi.outbreak[[w]]
plot_transmission_network <- function(sim_output) {
  
  sm <- sim_output$status.matrix
  
  # --- 1. Data Prep ---
  infected_indices <- which(sm$infected != 0)
  if(length(infected_indices) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  nodes <- sm[infected_indices, ]
  nodes$infected_id <- as.character(nodes$infected_id)
  nodes$infector <- as.character(nodes$infector)
  
  nodes <- nodes[, c("infected_id", "time.of.infection", "infector")]
  edges <- nodes[!is.na(nodes$infector), c("infector", "infected_id")]
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = nodes, directed = TRUE)
  
  # --- 2. Initial Layout ---
  l <- layout_as_tree(g, flip.y = FALSE)
  l[,1] <- V(g)$time.of.infection
  
  # --- 3. First Pass: Rough Grouping & Spacing ---
  # Group nodes by integer time steps
  time_bin <- 1.0 
  l_df <- data.frame(id=1:nrow(l), x=l[,1], y=l[,2])
  l_df$group <- round(l_df$x / time_bin)
  
  unique_grps <- sort(unique(l_df$group))
  
  min_y_gap <- 5.0 
  
  for(g_id in unique_grps) {
    idx <- which(l_df$group == g_id)
    if(length(idx) > 0) {
      curr_y <- l_df$y[idx]
      ord <- order(curr_y)
      idx_sorted <- idx[ord]
      n <- length(idx)
      
      span <- (n - 1) * min_y_gap
      new_y <- seq(-span/2, span/2, length.out = n)
      l_df$y[idx_sorted] <- new_y
    }
  }
  l[,2] <- l_df$y
  
  # --- 4. Second Pass: Collision Repulsion ---
  n_nodes <- nrow(l)
  
  # If nodes are closer than X=1.5 and Y=2.5, push them apart.
  thresh_x <- 1.5 
  thresh_y <- 2.5
  
  # Iterate to resolve overlaps
  for(iter in 1:50) {
    moved <- FALSE
    for(i in 1:(n_nodes-1)) {
      for(j in (i+1):n_nodes) {
        
        dx <- abs(l[i,1] - l[j,1])
        dy <- abs(l[i,2] - l[j,2])
        
        # Check strict overlap
        if(dx < thresh_x && dy < thresh_y) {
          
          overlap <- thresh_y - dy
          shift <- overlap / 2 + 0.1 # Push them apart
          
          if(l[i,2] >= l[j,2]) {
            l[i,2] <- l[i,2] + shift
            l[j,2] <- l[j,2] - shift
          } else {
            l[i,2] <- l[i,2] - shift
            l[j,2] <- l[j,2] + shift
          }
          moved <- TRUE
        }
      }
    }
    if(!moved) break 
  }
  
  # --- 5. Plot Limits ---
  x_range <- range(l[,1])
  y_range <- range(l[,2])
  
  x_limits <- c(x_range[1] - 1, x_range[2] + 2)
  max_y <- max(abs(y_range)) + 1 # Add buffer
  y_limits <- c(-max_y, max_y)
  
  # --- 6. Plotting ---
  plot(g, 
       layout = l,
       rescale = FALSE, 
       asp = 0,         
       xlim = x_limits, 
       ylim = y_limits,   
       
       vertex.shape = "circle", 
       vertex.size = 50,         
       vertex.color = "white", 
       vertex.frame.color = NA, 
       
       vertex.label = V(g)$name,
       vertex.label.color = "black",
       vertex.label.font = 2,
       vertex.label.cex = 1,
       
       edge.color = "firebrick",
       edge.width = 1.0,
       edge.arrow.size = 0.35,
       edge.curved = 0.2,       
       
       main = "Transmission Tree"
  )
  
  axis(1, at = pretty(x_limits), col = "gray40", col.axis = "gray40")
  mtext("Time (Days)", side = 1, line = 2.5, col = "gray40")
  
}
plot_transmission_network(plot_data)
```





```{r}
#Input parameters - fixed

ct.rates<-2 #avg number of daily contacts per day
nSeeds<-1 #number of cases starting the epidemic

#pathogen<-"COVID-19" # or "FLU"

# Fixed contact network (random network Erdos-Renyi)
A <- make_network_er(n = 24, p = 0.15)

for (i in 1:nSim){
  print(i)
  
  epi.outbreak[[i]] <- sim.epi(
  n = n,
  ct.rates = 2,
  nSeeds = 1,
  inf.param = inf.param,
  t.stop = t.stop,
  k = 0.2,
  nu_mean = 4.5,
  nu_sd = 2.0,
  mean_ip = 6,
  sd_ip = 2,
  A = A
)
}
```
